tolet_sources.notes: Checked 2026-10-12. The rentals URL falls back to 'Property in Joypurhat' with the text '2 results for Property in Joypurhat' and 'That may be all for Joypurhat at this time'. Both Joypurhat ads are for sale (61-decimal land in Kalai, a 3-bed apartment in Joypurhat Sadar), so there are 0 rental, room, mess or sublet ads. https://bikroy.com/joypurhat/real-estate and https://jiji.com.bd/joypurhat/real-estate (302 to bikroy) show the same. Bikroy shows no post dates on list pages.

tolet_sources.notes: The first load shows 12 Joypurhat Sadar listings, all in the Family category: Shekhpara, Natunhat, Khanjanpur and unnamed Sadar locations, mostly 2-bed. A 'Load More Posts' button means there may be more. Upazila pages: Kalai 1 listing (https://www.thetolet.com/bd/property-area/rajshahi/joypurhat/kalai); Akkelpur, Khetlal and Panchbibi show 'No results found'. Listing dates I opened: #154556 (Shekhpara, 4,500, to-let from July) updated 12 Jun 2026; #147407 (Natunhat, 7,000) 28 Apr 2026; #95611 (4,000) 01 Sep 2025. Every listing shows availability 'Not Sure', and contact details need a login. No bachelor or mess listings were visible.

train.name: Bangladesh Railway e-ticket website
train.helpline: 131 (Bangladesh Railway call centre, general railway information); app support +880 1313-096301, support@eticket.railway.gov.bd
train.notes: This is the official site, linked from railway.gov.bd as 'রেলওয়ে ই-টিকিট' (page last updated 11 Oct 2026). eticket.railway.gov.bd is robots-disallowed, so I could not open it to check its rules (advance days, NID). railway.gov.bd warns that social-media groups sell tickets at inflated prices through fake accounts and advises buying only through official channels. I found no Joypurhat-specific online-ticket rule; Joypurhat is an ordinary station in the e-ticket search (train list and fares are in round-1 transport.json). The railway.gov.bd e-ticketing static page was last updated 27 Mar 2022.

train.name: Rail Sheba (রেল সেবা) official app
train.helpline: +880 1313-096301 (support phone on the Play listing); support@eticket.railway.gov.bd
train.notes: The Play listing names the developer as BANGLADESH RAILWAY, with 5M+ downloads and a last update of Sep 11, 2025. It describes itself as 'the official app for Bangladesh Railway' for buying intercity tickets online (search, seat choice, MFS/card payment, e-ticket download). railway.gov.bd links to this exact package. The package id still carries the old operator's 'shohoz' prefix.

bus.name: Shohoz
bus.notes: A Dhaka-Joypurhat route URL exists at https://www.shohoz.com/bus-tickets/dhaka-to-joypurhat (indexed by search as 'Dhaka to Joypurhat'), but it renders the generic Shohoz homepage with no route-specific content, so the user has to search from the form. Hanif Enterprise's Shohoz-run site has a Joypurhat to Dhaka search page (page title 'Bus Tickets from joypurhat to dhaka|Buy Bus Tickets Online - Shohoz'); its homepage lists only 'Joypurhat to Dhaka', with no Dhaka to Joypurhat route. Hanif's general-queries number on that site is 01755-538881. SR Travels' site srtravelsbd.com is also a Shohoz-format site whose search page title in search results reads 'Bus Tickets from dhaka to joypurhat', but it is robots-disallowed, so I did not open it. Nabil Paribahan's Shohoz-run site does not list Joypurhat. Shohoz app: 'Shohoz' by SHOHOJ LTD., 1M+ downloads, updated Jul 7, 2026, covering bus, air, launch, event and park tickets.

bus.name: bdtickets (Robi Axiata)
bus.notes: Route pages exist for Dhaka to Joypurhat and Joypurhat to Dhaka (https://bdtickets.com/popular-routes/joypurhat-to-dhaka), but they are rendered by JavaScript, so I could not read operators or fares from them. Hotline 16460 per Prothom Alo (Aug 2018), the 16460 printed on bdtickets-run operator sites, and +8809610016460 on the new app's listing. Two Android apps, both by ROBI AXIATA PLC.: com.bdtickets.bd ('bdtickets: Online Bus Tickets', updated Aug 31, 2026, 1K+ downloads) and the older com.bluetech.bdtickets.launcher ('BDTICKETS', updated May 18, 2026, 500K+). Operators: Ahad Enterprise's site (ahadenterprise-bd.com, on bdtickets/BusBD infrastructure, support@bdtickets.com, call 16460) lists the route 'Dhaka->Joypurhat'. Shyamoli N.R Travels' site shyamoliparibahan-bd.com (same infrastructure) has Joypurhat as a 'Going To' destination. jamunaline.com is also on bdtickets but lists no Joypurhat route; it may be a different 'Jamuna Line' from the Dhaka-Joypurhat operator.

bus.name: Shyamoli Paribahan official ticket site (shyamolitickets.com)
bus.notes: The 'All Available Routes' list includes Dhaka ⟺ Joypurhat, Chittagong ⟺ Joypurhat (https://shyamolitickets.com/search/CHITTAGONG/JOYPURHAT) and Sylhet ⟺ Joypurhat (https://shyamolitickets.com/search/SYLHET/JOYPURHAT). Footer: 'Powered By' Semicon Private Ltd. Trips load by JavaScript, so no fares or times were readable. The Play app 'Shyamoli Paribahan (SP)' lists its developer as an individual (IFTEKHARUL ALAM), has 10K+ downloads, was updated Aug 19, 2025 and links to shyamolitickets.com. Both the shyamolitickets.com page and the app call themselves Shyamoli Paribahan's, but neither proves it is the operator's own official channel.

Joypurhat coverage is not confirmed: jatri.co/bus lists no routes, and ticket.jatri.co (operator and route pages) is robots-disallowed.

bus.name: BusBD
bus.notes: bbl.busbd.com.bd and gobusbd.com are robots-disallowed, so not checked. Operator sites for Ahad, Shyamoli N.R (shyamoliparibahan-bd.com) and Jamuna Line load their assets from static-busbd.bdtickets.com and use support@bdtickets.com, which suggests BusBD is part of bdtickets' platform. Use bdtickets.

train_live.method: SMS: 'TR <space> train number' (or train name) to 16318
train_live.details: railway.gov.bd's Train Tracking & Monitoring System (TTMS) PDF says passengers can send 'tr <space> Train no.' or 'tr <space> Train name' to 16318 (its example is TR 705, Ekota Express, which stops at Joypurhat). The reply gives train location, departure time, next station and stop, and delay. It names Grameenphone, Robi and Banglalink as supported. Cost is not stated officially. Third-party railwayticket.bd says 'Standard operator SMS fees apply (৳4 + VAT)', may vary by operator, and lists GP, Banglalink, Robi, Airtel and Teletalk.

Play Store URL: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.shohoz.dtrainpwa. The listing description covers ticket search, purchase and e-ticket download only; it does not mention live train tracking, location or running status, so live tracking in the app is not confirmed.

railway.gov.bd links to a 'ট্রেন ট্রাকিং মনিটরিং সিস্টেম' (TTMS) page; its content is dated 23 Mar 2015 and it only holds the PDF above. The PDF describes control-room monitoring plus the SMS service, not a public web map. I found no official public live-tracking web page. eticket.railway.gov.bd is robots-disallowed, so I could not check whether it has train status.

Bangladesh Railway call centre 131, callable from any number, gives 'information, services, and assistance related to railway operations' (Financial Express, 10 Sep 2024). railway.gov.bd lists 131 for railway service information. Neither source says explicitly that it gives live train position.

train_live.method: railwayticket.bd live train tracking web page
train_live.details: UNOFFICIAL. It is not a .gov.bd domain, although it calls itself 'Official'. Search by train name, number or route at https://railwayticket.bd/live-train-tracking/ (per-train pages like /live-train-tracking/train/721). Its own FAQ says the web tracker estimates position from the timetable, not live GPS, and recommends the 16318 SMS for delays. Some train data on the page is inconsistent.

bus_online.notes: The route page https://www.shohoz.com/bus-tickets/dhaka-to-joypurhat loads but shows generic homepage content. https://www.shohoz.com/bus-tickets/booking/bus/search?fromcity=Dhaka&tocity=Joypurhat&doj=20-Oct-2026 loads a 'Searching for buses' page with a 'Filters' label, but the server-rendered route line reads 'undefined to undefined'. So I could not confirm that from, to or date parameters prefill on shohoz.com, and the date format is unconfirmed. Shohoz-run operator sites do accept '/booking/bus/search?fromcity=<city>&tocity=<city>': for example, Hanif's Joypurhat to Dhaka page is titled with that route. Trip lists and filter options load by JavaScript, so I could not confirm whether AC/non-AC is shown per trip or can be filtered. Recommend linking https://www.shohoz.com/bus-tickets and telling users to pick Dhaka to Joypurhat. Helpline 16374.

bus_online.search_url_format: https://shyamolitickets.com/search/{FROM}/{TO} (upper-case city names; the date is picked on the page and defaulted to the current day)
bus_online.ac_nonac_filter: yes: 'Coach Type' filter with AC, Non-Ac, AC/Non-Ac
bus_online.notes: The route URL is linked from the site's own 'All Available Routes' list. Trips did not render without JavaScript, so per-trip coach type, fares and times are unconfirmed. No date URL parameter was confirmed. Helpline 09644 664466 (24x7).

Popular-route pages exist for both directions, but their content is JavaScript-rendered and was not readable. The operators shown are confirmed through their bdtickets-run sites (Ahad lists 'Dhaka->Joypurhat'; Shyamoli N.R has Joypurhat as a destination), not through bdtickets' own route page. Ahad's site says in general that the company runs AC, non-AC and sleeper coaches, but not which ones serve Joypurhat. Helpline 16460.
Jatri sells intercity bus tickets, but ticket.jatri.co is robots-disallowed and jatri.co/bus lists no routes, so Joypurhat coverage is unconfirmed.

searched_but_not_found: Parlours: only Cybo's Bangla yellow pages had a usable Joypurhat list (18 beauty salons and 12 barbers). I left out 4 permanently-closed entries, 1 unnamed 'সেলুন' and 3 barber entries with person-like or garbled names ('The le', 'Nd Fayed', 'Showrov'). No source gave hours, services, prices, appointment or home-service info. Facebook pages (robots-disallowed), helpmecovid.com (robots-disallowed), placedigger (0 Joypurhat beauty results), locale.online and mapsus.net gave nothing usable, and the English www.cybo.com pages returned errors. No parlours were found in Akkelpur, Khetlal or Panchbibi, and only one barber in Kalai. Mess/hostel: Cybo lists 116 'hostel' entries for Joypurhat, but only the first page (25) could be read; later pages returned errors, so about 91 more named messes were not captured. I left out 4 entries that are not messes or have person-like names ('কফি শপ', 'Probal Prottoy', 'Mostafiz here', 'MJ'). No mess, hostel or agency publishes rent or vacancy anywhere I could read. I found no to-let agency for Joypurhat. The Govt College website and Wikipedia pages have no hostel data. I found no working women's hostel (Women Affairs Dept) for Joypurhat. Vacancy data: no source gives a dated, confirmed vacancy. thetolet.com has the only recent Joypurhat to-let ads (latest updated 12 Jun 2026, availability 'Not Sure'), toletbd.app's are from Dec 2024 to Jan 2025, and Bikroy and varadeal have 0 Joypurhat rentals. Trains: eticket.railway.gov.bd and openstreetmap.org are robots-disallowed. Budgets: the shared WebSearch limit (200) and the hourly WebFetch budget were both used up, so the Cybo hostel pages 2-5 and upazila-level Cybo pages could not be fetched; a later run could finish them.
